text: Once the proud and noble rulers of the skies, now split, twisted and corrupted by the forces of change, the terrible two-headed Chaos Dragons are nightmarish and malevolent predators.
Giant Spiders are the size of small horses and known to hunt in ravenous packs tob ring down their prey.
Griffons are not ravenous and frenetic killers such as Manticores, instead a Griffon strikes with swift and precise grace, every motion poised and controlled.
Unicorns are proud and mystical creatures that dwell in or near forests, particularly those that are rich in magical energies such Athel Loren.
Great Stags are magical beasts that are closely connected to the most ancient of forests and it is said that when they emerge from their arboreal shelters, that great deeds are at hand.
Terradons are enormous flying reptiles that haunt the skies above the primordial jungles of the world.

Ripperdactyls are terrors of the sky. These reptilian predators hone their killer instincts by attacking everything they see with a savage series of stabs and rakes that can slice a man or horse in half.
Great Cave Squigs are at the sharp end of the undeground ecosystem. These voracious things are little more than massive fang-ridged mouths on powerful springy legs.
